bounded_predicate: Outside configured ignorePackages (default *.internal and *.internal.*), visit public/protected class scopes and report data class names; internal/private classes stop this visitor descent.

positive.intent: An implicit public data class and a protected data class in a public envelope are both part of the opted-in library API policy.

negative.intent: Internal/private data types and public ordinary classes are legal alternatives; a nested default-public data class cannot make its internal enclosing class externally visible.

suppression.intent: Genuine file-scoped upstream suppression only on the package-isolated copy. Preserve every positive range from the byte-identical unsuppressed neighbor. No host finding filter or ktChecker-ID suppression alias.

limitations: Explicit opt-in library binary-compatibility convention only. No baseline ABI, consumer graph, released artifact or actual compatibility break is analyzed.
An ignored package is a name-based exemption, not Kotlin visibility. Internal/private enclosing scopes stop visitor recursion by the pinned source predicate.
The public application-state result is retained as a policy limit, never represented as a universal defect or silently filtered.
No real library compilation, ABI measurement, version equivalence or release qualification.
